senses.definition: n.[m.] dub.; פ׳ Ju 5:7; sf. פִּרְזוֹנוֹ v 11 (LagBN 119), poss. coll. rural population, rustics, Bachm Bu (the latter as gen. obj. after צִדְקֹת righteous acts to the peasants); > 𝔊 Thes Be leaders and leadership (cf. [פֶּרֶז]); text very uncertain; on v 7 see [פְּרָזָה] supr.
